sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: Acceptance control plane replaces whole-directory review with immutable changed-set and complete Consumer Closure evidence, deterministic checks, typed routing, isolated Bootstrap review, and Acceptance-owned finalization.

sections.title: Authority
sections.content: VDD owns draft and plan-ready; maintainer owns implementation-authorized and non-authorizing supervised decisions; Quick Dev owns implementation-complete; Acceptance alone owns acceptance-passed. Bootstrap evidence never authorizes lifecycle state.

sections.title: Admission And Routing
sections.content: Acceptance requires a current identity-bound implementation-complete handoff, resolved immutable baseline, frozen candidate, manifest, closure, and required-check evidence. Deterministic failure launches no reviewers. Routes are deterministic_only, focused repair, full conformance, or manual pause; registered risks force full or pause.

sections.title: Review Execution
sections.content: Complete Bootstrap review uses isolated Blind Hunter, Edge Case Hunter, and Acceptance Auditor roles over frozen closure identities. Required checks are real contract-projected executions. Accepted P0/P1 findings require an independent verifier under existing policy.

sections.title: Authority Delivery
sections.content: In-budget selected authority is delivered in full, continuing Partial reads to Complete. Over-budget content requires parent-owned hash-bound inclusive Range Projection. Segment descriptors, snapshots, access proofs, receipts, retry, and folds share stable canonical identity.

sections.title: Recovery And Verification
sections.content: Append-only Process Events distinguish liveness from effective progress. Heartbeats and output do not refresh no-progress. Leases are derived from process identity, liveness, progress, and terminal state; recovery is bounded, identity-bound, and non-authorizing. M0 through M2 require semantic parity and 8-13-scale regression before replacing whole-directory defaults.
